flows.title: Download a monthly statement
steps: From the Manage page, select Your transactions.
At the top right side of the Transactions table, click Monthly statement.
Select the currency balance, card or bank the statement is for, and the month, the year and the file format, PDF or CSV.
Click Download. The statement opens in a new window.

flows.title: Export the list of transactions
steps: From the Manage page, select Your transactions, and filter the list if only some transactions are wanted; only the filtered results are exported.
Use the icons at the top right corner of the Transactions section to export a CSV or PDF file, or to print the table.
